name: Loss Prevention & Shrinkage core scenarios
description: Real Store Operations: Loss Prevention & Shrinkage Q&A pairs grounded in monthly shrinkage, category losses, POS audit exceptions, and industry benchmarks: shrinkage % by store, shrinkage dollars by cause, audit exception frequencies, and retail shrinkage benchmarks.

parts.text: What is our shrinkage percentage across stores for the month of June 2026?

In June 2026, overall shrinkage averaged 1.35% across stores. High-risk locations Downtown Flagship (STORE-001) and City Galleria (STORE-004) recorded the highest shrinkage rates at 2.40%, while Suburban Plaza (STORE-002) achieved the lowest at 1.00%, based on internal monthly shrinkage data.
What are the primary causes of shrink dollars across our stores?

Known Theft is the primary driver of shrink dollars, accounting for approximately 40% of total loss across stores, followed by Unknown Loss (30%), Admin Error (15%), and Damage (15%), based on internal monthly shrinkage cause data.
Which POS register audit exception type is most frequently flagged across stores?

High Value Refund and Unscanned Item exceptions occurred most frequently, with high-risk stores flagging up to 17 events daily and multiple employees under investigation, based on internal register audit exception data.
How does our average store shrinkage percentage compare to retail industry shrinkage benchmarks?

Our store shrinkage rate averages 1.35%, which compares favorably to the national retail industry benchmark of 1.4-1.6% of sales, based on internal shrinkage data and external retail industry benchmark research.
